Configure basic device settings includin: Configure basic device settings including hostname, location, and timezone. These settings identify your device on the network and ensure proper time management.
Configure local log buffer and remote sy: Configure local log buffer and remote syslog support to send log messages to a remote syslog server in addition to local logging.
Configure network interface settings inc: Configure network interface settings including IP addressing, VLAN configuration, and DHCP settings. Network interfaces connect your device to different network segments and services.
Configure NTP (Network Time Protocol) se: Configure NTP (Network Time Protocol) servers for time synchronisation. NTP keeps the device clock accurate by synchronising with reliable time servers.
Configure quality of service to prioriti: Configure quality of service to prioritise latency-sensitive traffic and share the available bandwidth between clients.
Configure the 802.1X service for port-ba: Configure the 802.1X service for port-based network access control, authenticating wired clients against a RADIUS server before granting access.
Configure the AdGuard Home service for n: Configure the AdGuard Home service for network-wide DNS filtering. AdGuard Home blocks advertising and tracking domains for every client on the network.
Configure the LLDP (Link Layer Discovery: Configure the LLDP (Link Layer Discovery Protocol) service to announce system information to connected network devices for network topology discovery.
Configure the local RADIUS service setti: Configure the local RADIUS service settings. The RADIUS service provides authentication and authorization services for network devices.
Configure the mDNS (Multicast DNS) servi: Configure the mDNS (Multicast DNS) service for local network service discovery. mDNS allows devices to advertise and discover services on the local network without a DNS server.
Configure the SSH (Secure Shell) server: Configure the SSH (Secure Shell) server for secure remote access to the device.
Configure the Tailscale service to join: Configure the Tailscale service to join the device to a private mesh network, optionally advertising local routes or acting as an exit node.
Configure wireless radio settings for di: Configure wireless radio settings for different frequency bands. Adjust power levels, channels, and other radio parameters to optimize wireless performance.
